svg.text: From retrieved evidence to an answer
Each retrieval route selects its own synthesis function; peer comparison always uses a deterministic table.
No LLM call on this path
mock=True, no model, or invoke error → template.
The functions return answer strings. The retrieval router adds metadata; no token streaming or citation validator runs here.
